title: C++/Lua API Naming Convention Parity
description: Every engine feature implemented in C++ must also be exposed to Lua with naming parity: C++ uses PascalCase (GetPosition), Lua uses snake_case (uz.scene.get_position). Both languages must have access to the same capabilities. Lua API files are organized by domain: api/scene/ (entities, transforms, lights), api/core/ (camera, input, time, math), api/renderer/ (render path, debug modes). Registration via LuaRegister*API() called from LuaVM::Init().
whenToUse: After implementing any new C++ system or feature. When adding new ECS components. When exposing debug/editor functionality to scripts.
whenNotToUse: For internal engine implementation details that should never be script-accessible. For performance-critical tight loops that would be slower in Lua.
